sourceChecks.text: The king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, “There is yet one man by whom we may inquire of the LORD, Micaiah the son of Imlah; but I hate him, for he does not prophesy good concerning me, but evil.” Jehoshaphat said, “Don’t let the king say so.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Then the king of Israel called an officer, and said, “Quickly get Micaiah the son of Imlah.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The messenger who went to call Micaiah spoke to him, saying, “See now, the prophets declare good to the king with one mouth. Please let your word be like the word of one of them, and speak good.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Micaiah said, “As the LORD lives, what the LORD says to me, that I will speak.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: When he had come to the king, the king said to him, “Micaiah, shall we go to Ramoth Gilead to battle, or shall we forbear?” He answered him, “Go up and prosper; and the LORD will deliver it into the hand of the king.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Then Zedekiah the son of Chenaanah came near and struck Micaiah on the cheek, and said, “Which way did the LORD’s Spirit go from me to speak to you?”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Micaiah said, “Behold, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to hide yourself.”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: The king of Israel said, “Take Micaiah, and carry him back to Amon the governor of the city and to Joash the king’s son.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。

sourceChecks.text: Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, the LORD has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 固定WEB本文を確認し、名指しまたは文脈上の照応を点検。
